claims.claim: Conifex secured up to $2 million in additional non-repayable funding from the Government of Canada.
claims.episode_span: The program supplies non-repayable funding to support wages at affected facilities, such as the $2 million awarded to Conifex for its Mackenzie sawmill.
claims.source_title: Conifex Receives Additional Regional Tariff Response Funding
claims.supporting_quote: Conifex Timber Inc. (“Conifex”) (TSX: CFF) announced today that it has secured up to $2 million in additional non-repayable funding from the Government of Canada, through Pacific Economic Development Canada, under the Regional Tariff Response Initiative.
